propositions: code_health lens must compute real metrics against both Python and non-Python (Go/TypeScript) client fixtures when external analyzers (scc, jscpd, lizard) are present
code_health must report Unavailable status without fabricated data or crashes when analyzer tools and metrics extra are absent

agent_process and git_delta metrics must compute correctly for both Python and non-Python fixtures across both analyzer-present and analyzer-absent states
